capability: Split one blurry question into small ones
title: Five small gates, not one.

hook.picture: Close on the whale holding up one big card to a pod: 'scam?'. The pod's answer ring wobbles between yes and no.
hook.words: Is this email a scam? Maybe.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We asked one big question and got mush.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: ML researcher reading an eval sheet

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: one huge question card feeds one wobbling ring. Three mixed emails hit it, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. Each lands on the wrong side.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: One question hides five different ones.

stakes.body: Real emails are flagged and real scams pass. The score looks like a model problem when it is really a question problem.

solution_hint: Ask five small questions, not one big one.

metaphor.body: The big question card splits along its folds into five small cards. Each passes its own small gate, and the decision is read off five clear lamps instead of one blurry ring.

steps.picture: The big card splits along its folds into five small cards. Each slides to its own small gate on the line.
steps.words: One big question becomes five small ones.

steps.picture: Each small gate lights crisply: four pass and one shuts. No lamp wobbles.
steps.words: Each small answer is easy to check.
steps.sound: Five short tuned pings, a pentatonic run

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28): the decision card reads the five lamps in a row. One shut lamp is enough to hold it.
steps.sound: The five pings land as one chord

steps.picture: A tick lands under each small gate.

real_case.claim: In JEV-works, a phishing task scored 62.6% as one question and 95.1% when decomposed into five narrow questions. A two-line regex scored 91.8%.

honest_limit.picture: Still. A blank card (an empty email) slides into a small gate. The ring reads high, and the gate passes it with a confident glow.

not_this.body: Sure-sounding is not the same as right.

ending_pattern.body: Five steady lamps: the single wobbling ring is replaced by five crisp lamps in the same frame, and the right email passes.
ending_pattern.callback: The single wobbling ring of bar 1 is replaced by five steady lamps in the same frame.

end_belief.body: Split the question until each answer is checkable.
